purpose: Lumina intent understanding - the whole intent corpus, one split

sources.name: authored seed set
sources.note: No corpus in data/ carries Lumina intent labels. These sentences were written for the purpose and are not real patient language.

sources.name: pooled intent addon rows
sources.note: Formerly datasets/intent_addon. Public small talk and Kaggle intent patterns plus authored dialect rows for the six meta intents.

provenance.purpose: Adds the six meta intents Lumina lacks (GREETING, GOODBYE, THANKS, ABOUT_BOT, BOT_FEEDBACK, DISENGAGE) and more real-ish rows for existing intents

sources.conversation_csv_smalltalk: public, English, GENERAL_CONVERSATION only, capped at 200
sources.lumina_authored_final: authored, EN + MSA + Gulf + Egyptian + Levantine + Arabizi

excluded.all intents.json responses: hard-coded hotline numbers and advice; never reuse

honest_limits: Report scores per source_type: authored rows test templates, not users.
Arabic BOT_FEEDBACK exists only as authored rows; a regex over real dialogues matched symptoms ('stupid', 'recurring') and was dropped.
DISENGAGE can co-occur with distress ('leave me alone'); safety runs first.
Existing Lumina intents still have only authored seeds; none of this is clinician-labelled.
provenance.note: Pooled rows of the former datasets/intent_addon. Kept as a source, not a dataset: data_prep/build_intent.py merges these with the authored seeds and makes one split over the result.

honest_limits: Under a thousand authored sentences plus seven hundred mixed rows is a seed, not a corpus.
Scores measure generalisation to unseen phrasings and unseen meanings within this set - not to real patient language.
The twelve Lumina topic intents are authored only; nothing in them is real patient text and none of it is clinician-labelled.
Report scores per source_type: authored rows test templates, not users.
Synthetic rows are down-weighted to 0.5 in training and still counted in full when scoring, so the reported numbers are not flattered by them.
The model stays `candidate` until retrained on reviewed real data.

excluded_intents.reason: Safety routing is owned by lumina/safety.py (deterministic rules + a calibrated distress head). A second uncalibrated path to a crisis decision would be a liability, not a feature.

split_policy: grouped by meaning-family, stratified by intent; no family spans two splits
